summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) using wave-based parallel execution, including creating account cleanup helpers, staging baseline tests, media/streaming E2E suites, and batch download tests.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed (34-01 cleanup helpers wired into all 10 specs, 34-04 BYO load test plan documented). Wave 2 launched (34-02 media tests completed and merged). 34-03 hit a git lock issue and was retried. Staging journey timing baselines captured after fixing BASE_URL config and Web3Auth timeout issues. Load test .env scaffolded for Pinata credentials.

repo: Playwright config does not respect BASE_URL env var by default — requires explicit `process.env.BASE_URL` override in playwright.config.ts and conditional webServer block to skip local dev server when targeting staging.
Web3Auth SDK initialization takes >20s on staging, exceeding the 20s timeout hardcoded in journey-timing.spec.ts for the wallet-login-button visibility check.
cleanup-helpers.ts deleteAccountViaPage calls the API at localhost:3000 — does not derive API URL from the page's origin, causing 401s when tests run against staging.

The SDK-level load test harness (tests/load/) supports high client counts (50→1000) via byo-capacity-ceiling scenario and uses CipherBoxSDK clients rather than Playwright browsers — far more suitable than the Playwright load-test.spec.ts for 200+ concurrent users.
Default Pinata endpoint is https://api.pinata.cloud — used by PinataProvider in the load test harness.
Staging API health endpoint: https://api-staging.cipherbox.cc/health returns NestJS Terminus format with database status.

Wave executor agents commit with --no-verify and run in isolated git worktrees (branches named worktree-agent-{id}); orchestrator must cherry-pick commits back to the phase branch, often encountering STATE.md merge conflicts.

code.finding: Added BASE_URL env var support and conditional webServer skip when BASE_URL is set to a non-localhost value.
waitFor timeout for wallet-login-button increased beyond 20s to accommodate Web3Auth cold-start on staging.
deleteAccountViaPage fixed to derive API URL from the page's current origin rather than hardcoding localhost:3000.
Scaffolded with LOAD_TEST_API_URL=https://api-staging.cipherbox.cc, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET, BYO_IPFS_ENDPOINT/PROTOCOL set; BYO_IPFS_AUTH_TOKEN left blank for user to populate.
Staging baselines captured: login-to-vault 22,889ms (Web3Auth-heavy), upload-to-visible 906ms (100KB), share-to-accessible 1,483ms.

workflow: Cherry-picking commits from agent worktrees to the phase branch frequently produces STATE.md merge conflicts — take the worktree version as it reflects the agent's completed state.
Playwright browser-based load tests (5 Chromium tabs) are not suitable for 200+ concurrent user testing; SDK-level harness should be used instead.
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error from Claude Code task completion is a runtime bug, not an agent failure — verify via SUMMARY.md existence and git log presence.
When a git lock file blocks an agent mid-execution, the agent fails and must be retried rather than resumed.

friction: BASE_URL env var not respected by Playwright config required manual fix before any staging tests could run.
Web3Auth >20s cold-start on staging caused journey-timing test failure; hardcoded 20s timeout in spec needed patching.
deleteAccountViaPage cleanup helper assumed localhost:3000 API URL, causing 401 errors on every staging test cleanup — required detecting API URL from page origin.
Git lock file conflict caused 34-03 agent to fail mid-execution, requiring a retry.
STATE.md merge conflicts on every cherry-pick from agent worktrees added manual resolution overhead.
5-client Playwright browser load test running in background with some clients hitting timeouts — not ideal for real load measurement.
Cherry-picking individual commits from worktree branches is fragile — required multiple stash/unstash/conflict resolution cycles.
